correctness.rationale: Equality in the facet-area Cauchy–Schwarz bound S<=8/sqrt(3)*sqrt(det A)*sqrt(tr(A^-1)) requires equal edge scales and constant diagonal of U^T C U. A vertex y is the normalized sum of orthonormal columns u_j, so projected columns in y-perp form an equilateral triple at angles phi+2pi(j-1)/3. The constant-diagonal residual is a sum of first and second harmonics. On this triple, second harmonics alias first with phase 3phi; vanishing of all three residuals iff d1^2+d2^2=2(b1^2+b2^2), including the degenerate zero/zero case. This is equivalent to tr_{y-perp}(D^2)=4||P C y||^2 and expands exactly to F_C(y)=0. An independent exact SymPy check verified axial factor (a-b)^2(t-1)(9t-1), and the formula handles coincident eigenvalues and ball. All vectors real, y unit, C positive definite.
